# Catalogs

Lists the catalogs generated from the definition blocks, the terms, and the requirements of the specification's pages.

| Page | Summary |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Alerts](alerts.md) | Lists every alert with its severity, the requirements whose breach it detects, and its owner block. |
| [API operations](api-operations.md) | Lists every interface operation with its identifier, method, path, and owner block. |
| [Channels](channels.md) | Lists every register with its store, writers, readers, and owner block. |
| [Contributions](contributions.md) | Lists every RBAC grant and network rule with the running unit that carries it, the page that states it, and the requirement behind it. |
| [Custom resources](custom-resources.md) | Lists every custom resource kind with its group, version, scope, and owner block. |
| [Errors](errors.md) | Lists every error code, admission refusal, and condition reason with its status and owner block. |
| [Events](events.md) | Lists every event type with its emitting components, its payload, and its owner block. |
| [Glossary](glossary.md) | Lists every owned term with a one-sentence gloss and a link to its owner. |
| [Labels and annotations](labels.md) | Lists every label, annotation, finalizer, and readiness gate with its carriers, mutability, and owner block. |
| [Limits](limits.md) | Lists every limit with its value, unit, and owner block. |
| [Metrics](metrics.md) | Lists every metric with its type, labels, emitting components, and owner block. |
| [Requirements](requirements.md) | Lists every requirement identifier with its title and page. |
| [Settings](settings.md) | Lists every setting with its type, default, range, scopes, the components that read it, its tier presets, and its owner block. |
| [State machines](state-machines.md) | Lists every state machine with its object, its states, and its owner block. |
